text:
marta (People Ops): Working on a tiny 'peer evidence' add-on to the one-pager. Aim: one extra line where peers can paste a snippet/quote that signals impact. Draft below, thoughts?
kai (eng manager): Love the idea. Keeps reviews concrete. Could we add a confidence score 1-5?
li (frontend): +1 for confidence. Also suggest asking for a "context line" so the quote isn't floating.
jamal (people partner): Make it optional for ICs, mandatory for managers (to capture coaching examples). Also ensure it doesn't become a place for gossip.
marta (People Ops): Good point. Here's a proposed 'peer-evidence' mini-template to attach to self-reviews (copyable):
```
Peer evidence mini-snippet (optional for IC, recommended for managers)
- Context (1 line): where/how you worked with the peer
- Quote/snippet (1 line): exact sentence from peer or summary
- Signal (1 line): what this shows about impact / behavior
- Confidence (1-5): how certain you are this represents typical behavior
```
li (frontend): This looks great. One UX ask: add a single example so people copy faster.
marta (People Ops): Adding example: 
```
Context: Pulled the deploy rollback for feature X during 03/2026 outage
Quote: "Kai's runbook and calm comms saved us 20 minutes"
Signal: Reliable on-call leadership; reduces incident MTTR
Confidence: 4
```
kai (eng manager): Nice. Can we include a note to avoid using names for sensitive feedback?
okrbuddy-bot: :bell: Quick reminder — self-reviews + optional peer snippets due 2026-04-10 23:59 UTC. Upload at https://redwood/reviews
marta (People Ops): Finalized. I'll add the mini-snippet as an optional block in both IC and manager one-pagers and push to /handbook/templates. Will notify docs and send a short thread in #announcements tomorrow. Thanks :raised_hands:
